auth_mechanism: Authorization: Bearer(KeyRoulette 多 key 轮询);MiMo 用 api-key header
request_format: messages[],stream=true,stream_options.include_usage(Mistral 除外),tools[].function,按 host 注入 reasoning 参数,reasoning_content 回传
stream_framing: SSE data-only(不读 event:),[DONE] 结束
chunk_types: text delta,reasoning/reasoning_content delta(含 Mistral content[].thinking 变体),tool_calls 分片(index/id/name/arguments),images(data uri),annotations(url_citation),usage chunk,finish_reason
error_format: HTTP 非2xx:ErrorParser 递归解析 error/detail/message/description;流中 error payload 主动 cancel+close
cancellation_semantics: callbackFlow awaitClose→EventSource.cancel;trySendBlocking 失败即 cancel;无自动重连
harmony_reuse_notes: 解析层纯 Kotlin 可原样复用;OkHttp EventSource 换 @ohos.net.http(D-001);多行 data 兼容补丁必须保留

auth_mechanism: Authorization: Bearer;401 时 bearerResolver(forceRefresh) 重试一次
stream_framing: SSE+event: 字段(type 即事件名);无 [DONE] 依赖,靠 response.completed/incomplete 终止
error_format: 同 ErrorParser;流内 error 字段+response.failed→parseErrorDetail
harmony_reuse_notes: 解析表与 Reconciler 纯逻辑可搬;fc_*/call_* 双 id 体系与 replace 语义(withStreamArgsReplace)必须与 merge 层一起迁

auth_mechanism: Device authorization flow(client_id app_EMoamEEZ73f0CkXaXp7hrann);Bearer access_token+originator: amberagent_android+ChatGPT-Account-Id;401→refresh 重试一次
stream_framing: 手写 SSE 行解析(不走 OkHttp):readUtf8Line+空行分派+event:/data: 前缀,[DONE] 判停,显式 Accept: text/event-stream
cancellation_semantics: 普通 Flow,协程取消即中断读循环;generateText 也由流聚合
harmony_reuse_notes: 手写解析器是 HarmonyOS 最佳移植蓝本(零库依赖);token 存储 Android Keystore→HUKS;device flow 平台无关

request_format: model,messages[](text/image/thinking/tool_use/tool_result blocks),system[](cache_control ephemeral),max_tokens(默认64000),thinking.type=adaptive+output_config.effort,tools[].input_schema,倒数第二条 user 插 cache_control
chunk_types: text_delta,thinking_delta,signature_delta(进 metadata),redacted_thinking(忽略),tool_use(content_block_start),input_json_delta(无 tool id,靠事件顶层 index 注入 streamToolIndex 关联并行 tool),usage(message_delta),stop_reason
error_format: SSE event type=error→parseErrorDetail;HTTP 非2xx 同 ErrorParser;onEvent 内任何异常→cancel+close
harmony_reuse_notes: 协议层可原样复用;input_json_delta 无 id 的 index 关联规则是并行 tool 不串线关键,必须保留

request_format: systemInstruction,contents[](text/inlineData/functionCall/functionResponse),generationConfig(temperature/maxOutputTokens/responseModalities/thinkingConfig),tools.functionDeclarations(剔除不支持 schema 字段),googleSearch/urlContext,safetySettings 全 OFF
stream_framing: SSE data-only;每个 data 是完整 GenerateContentResponse JSON(增量 candidate,非 delta 协议)
chunk_types: candidates[].content.parts[]: text,thought=true→Reasoning,functionCall(无 id!流内分配 google-fc-* 稳定 id+stream index),inlineData(图片 base64,thought 草稿图丢弃),groundingMetadata→UrlCitation,usageMetadata,promptFeedback.blockReason(close error),finishReason
error_format: HTTP 非2xx: body error.message;块级 promptFeedback→RuntimeException;malformed event 不吞错 cancel+close
harmony_reuse_notes: 整包 JSON-per-event 解析最简单;tool 无 id 的流内发号逻辑必须随迁

auth_mechanism: (a)API key 作 query ?key=;(b)Service Account 私钥签 JWT 换 OAuth access token,Bearer
harmony_reuse_notes: ServiceAccount JWT 签名(RS256)需确认 HUKS/cryptoFramework 等价物;P1 后置

provider: Gemini Code Assist(Google 账号 OAuth)
auth_mechanism: Google OAuth Bearer+onboarding 获得 projectId(loadCodeAssist→onboardUser+LRO 轮询)
request_format: 标准 Gemini 体外包 {model,project,request:{...}};Gemini 3.x OFF 时不强制 thinkingLevel
stream_framing: SSE data-only;每个 chunk 再包一层 {"response":{...标准 chunk...}},解析时 unwrap
harmony_reuse_notes: 双层包装是唯一协议差异(unwrap 2 行可复用);OAuth 重定向/CustomTab 平台相关需重实现;token store→HUKS

endpoint: 各 provider 同 endpoint(非流式)
error_format: throw Exception("Failed to get response: code body");OpenAIProvider 外层参数被拒降级重试一次(仅在未 emit 任何 chunk 时;CancellationException 永不重试)
harmony_reuse_notes: 降级重试包装是纯逻辑,可原样复用
